root_idea.summary: The root centers on passage and penetration: moving through or onward, and thereby reaching or taking effect.
root_idea.development: Its lexical development extends from physical or temporal passage to continued advance, effective completion of affairs, forceful performance, and decisive enactment.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb with an independent dictionary citation form.
Quran-attested nominal form representing the verbal noun of مَضَى.

senses.definition: To advance, proceed, or go on.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of continuing along a course or undertaking; the Quranic forms include an imperative and expressions of continued movement or progress.

senses.definition: To pass on, pass away, or go by.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of entities and events that have gone forth or passed from the present; this includes the passing of a precedent or an earlier occurrence.
A verbal noun denoting passage or onward movement of entities or events.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of time: to pass or elapse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction مَضَى لَهُ when time is the subject or reference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To advance or act with penetrating energy, sharpness, vigor, and effectiveness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of pressing onward in a journey or acting vigorously and effectively in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a command, order, saying, or affair: to take effect, be carried out, or be accomplished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes مَضَى الأَمْرُ, مَضَى القَوْلُ, and مَضَى عَلَى الأَمْرِ; the latter may also describe carrying an undertaking through.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep to or apply oneself constantly and perseveringly to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use with عَلَى in which persistence, rather than mere movement, is foregrounded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sword: to cut, penetrate, or be sharp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing the cutting or penetrating efficacy of a sword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a contract, sale, oath, covenant, or similar undertaking take effect; to execute or perform it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV causative use with an undertaking as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an oath unconditional, decisive, and irreversibly binding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use with an oath, removing exception or qualification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To form or give a decided opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with رأي and related expressions of settled judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sign a writing, thereby rendering it effective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The writing becomes legally or practically effective through the signature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Penetrating, sharp, vigorous, effective, or proficient in action; excelling in performance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective used of a person or animal characterized by vigorous effective action, and of someone skilled or successful in carrying out a task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a command or order: effectual, having effect, and executed or performed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of an order that has taken effect or been carried out.
Especially used of time or a period that has already elapsed.
The act or mark by which a writing is signed and made effective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who performs affairs with energy and perseverance; an intensive epithet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive designation for a person characterized by energetic, persistent execution of affairs.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Energetic and effective action in an affair.
